title: Last 30-minute move, signed
notes: sign from 'rose/fell/moved +-x'; bottom third = flat, middle = small, top = big. Rank is 30-min move vs same minute, last 19-20 sessions.

title: Move since the open vs usual band
notes: 'above/below the usual move-from-the-open band' = outside; 'above the higher / below the lower ... inside or at the edge' = up/down inside; 'between the settled open and yesterday's close' = flat. Label is in sigma not opening-straddle units (rank is unit-free). 09-28 reads use an older template that does not say the side. The older 09-28 template (side not stated) answers None.

title: Afternoon leg since 14:00
notes: only reads at/after 14:30. Sign + tercile like TREND-01. Bug seen: at 14:00 the move is ~0 but ranks 'larger than 20 of 20, top third' - ignore pre-14:30 reads.

title: One-way hour, signed
source: net60 = C[t]-C[t-60]; path = sum_{i=0..11}|C[t-5i]-C[t-5i-5]|; eff = net60/path. |net60| bottom third vs this minute = 'no hour move'; else direction = sign(net60), one-way if |eff| ranks top half vs this minute, else two-way. Field: close of state/spx_jev/bars (or store spx_bars).
notes: price.hour_one_way is close but measures crossings of the hourly average, not net/summed-5-min efficiency; use bars. History: store spx_bars has 66 sessions (07-06 on), live bars files only 12 days.

title: Trend day or range day so far
notes: exact match: the variance-ratio sentence ends 'top third: building / middle: mixed / bottom: cancelling'. Omitted until 12 5-min returns since 10:00 (~11:00).

title: Move speeding up or fading
source: d20 = C[t-10]-C[t-30]; d10 = C[t]-C[t-10]; ratio = sign(d20)*d10 / (|d20|/2). 'reversing' if ratio < 0 by more than a fixed tolerance (in opening-straddle units: |d10|/em_open > tol); else rank ratio vs this minute: top third accelerating, middle steady, bottom fading. em_open from the diary row (state/reversion range_ruler.em_open).
notes: momentum.pace is unsigned and compares 10 vs the previous 10 minutes (not 20) with fixed 2/3 and 1.5 cuts, so it cannot give 'reversing'. Reversing when the ratio is negative and |d10| exceeds a fixed share of the read's sigma.

title: Pullback in the leg, signed
source: 60-min window [t-60,t]: net = C[t]-C[t-60]; leg only if |net| > this minute's median |net| on prior sessions. Up leg: ext = max high in window at minute i; push = ext-C[t-60]; giveback = (ext-C[t])/push; deep = giveback > this minute's median giveback; fast = (ext-C[t])/(60-i) > push/i. Mirror for down legs.
notes: two medians (leg size, giveback) per minute-of-day from prior sessions; spx_bars store covers it.

title: 60-minute range sweep: held or failed
source: H/L = max high / min low over bars [t-70,t-10); break up if max high of bars [t-10,t) > H + 0.02*sigma (fixed tolerance); held if C[t] > H else failed; mirror for down. sigma = read's sigma.
notes: no history needed; tolerance value (0.02 sigma here) is a design choice to fix.

title: Biggest 1-minute bar vs normal
source: ratio = max(high-low) / median(high-low) over the last 30 finished 1-min bars; rank vs same minute prior sessions (cut points e.g. <2/3 normal, 2/3-90% large, >=90% burst).
notes: price.minute_width only compares the current minute to today's typical minute with a fixed 2x cut; shock.burst is 5-minute moves. Use bars. Bars volume field is 0 for SPX (index), so no volume weighting.

title: Latest leg with or against the day
notes: first tercile (30-min move) bottom = quiet; second tercile (distance from yesterday's close) bottom 'near it' = flat day; else 'away from' = with, 'toward' = against.

title: Straddle held up vs clock decay
notes: tercile of 'times its usual share ... higher than k of n sessions at this minute'. Missing on 10-06 (row carried no straddle).

title: Last 30 min swing vs same half hour
notes: current template uses fifths (bottom fifth quiet / between ordinary / top fifth busy); 09-28 reads used terciles. vol.realized_vs_clock_rank is the same idea as a pace ratio.

title: Share of expected range used
notes: 'under / near / over the usual pace' terciles. iv.expected_move_used is the unranked alternative.

title: VIX move beyond what price explains
notes: ranked with VIX furthest above what price explains highest: top third = more fearful.

title: Same-day IV move beyond price
notes: top third = vol above what price explains. vol.straddle_reprice_30 is the straddle twin.

title: Skew change beyond price
notes: needs the lob_flow 0DTE tape; missing 10-06 (collector did not run). Prior-session history limited by lob_flow/raw (from 09-08, ~21 sessions); labels show 16-18 sessions.

title: Put tilt vs same minute
notes: words 'a steep put tilt / a usual tilt / a flat tilt'; 'calls are priced above puts, a call tilt' = tilted to calls. An older template ('steeper than k of n, past the flat rank') ran on early days - map from rank. Missing 10-06. The older template is mapped from its rank.

title: VVIX beyond VIX and price
notes: label ranks the size of the leftover only; sign = (VVIX change - explained), parsed from the two numbers. Leftover under the median = about as much; at/above median = more or less by sign.

title: Front fear shifting
notes: ranked with nine-day VIX gaining highest.

title: Priced move loaded by an event
notes: ruler part: 'this morning's sigma ruler is X times its N-session median ... (bottom|middle|top) third' = compressed/normal/swollen (vs prior mornings, once a day). Event part: parse the free-text calendar list 'name at HH:MM' and compare to read time. Missing 10-06. Answer = '<ruler>, <event>'.

title: Gap still holding
notes: sentence opens 'the gap up/down is still open' or 'there was no real gap' (a 'filled' opening should exist in code but has not occurred yet). Gap 'real' = vs last 20 days' gaps.

title: Distance from yesterday's close
notes: side + tercile ('near it / away from it / far from it'); plus 'mostly gap / mostly trading' from 'so the gap is N% of the day's move' (>=50% gap). Answer = '<position>; <driver>'.

title: Yesterday's range: accepted or rejected
notes: acceptance = 20 finished minutes beyond. Week high/low flag is NOT in any label: compute from store spx_bars (max high / min low of the prior 5 sessions) - bars, no ranking.

title: Yesterday's value area vs today's move
notes: value-area side from levels.prior_value; with/against from the sign of price.day_move (move since the settled open).

title: Fresh session extreme
notes: window is 30 min on live, 5 min on tape (as asked). Position: parse '(N% of the way up' and cut at 20/80 (label's own bands are 25/75). Minutes since last extreme: price.session_extreme_recent 'N minutes ago' (only shown when recent).

title: First-hour range break
notes: range.box_status is exactly the first-30-minute box (OPENING_BOX_MIN=30). 'extended' detail: range.first_hour ranks how far the break reached vs prior sessions' first-hour breaks.

title: Overnight range size (premarket)
notes: only on premarket-lane reads; live/tape reads must carry the day's last premarket value (09:28 checkpoint). Live reads take the day's last premarket read.

title: Opening size (bar, then range)
source: before 10:05: R5 = max high - min low of the 09:30-09:34 bars (sigma units), plus pace = sum |dC| of 1-min closes since 09:30; rank vs the same window on prior sessions (quartiles: quiet/normal/busy/very busy). From 10:05: R30 = max high - min low of the 09:35-10:04 bars, rank vs prior sessions (terciles narrow/normal/wide).
notes: fixed window, so ranking is vs prior sessions' same window. No label gives the first-5-min bar or the 09:35-10:04 range (range.today_vs_normal is range-so-far; tape.unit_vs_normal is tape-lane only). Ranked in points (prior sessions' sigma is not in the bars).

title: Break setup armed
notes: exact: 'a break upward/downward is armed', 'no break is armed now: ... expired without firing', 'no break is armed, and none expired'.

title: Signed distance from the gamma flip
notes: side from 'sigma above/below the gamma flip'; bottom third = near, middle = above/below, top = far. Units are sigma, not expected-move units (ranking is unit-free).

title: Gamma packed near spot
notes: APPROXIMATE: the ranked top-strike share in gex.magnet_distance ('its grip ... stronger than k of n sessions') is the 0DTE book only and not limited to one expected move; gex.heaviest_strike_grip uses fixed 4%/16% cuts. 0-7DTE within 1 EM is not built.

title: Signed distance from the heaviest strike
notes: strike 'above price' means SPX is below it. bottom third 'seated on it' = on it. PARTIAL: the after-14:00 1DTE magnet is dark (expiry_calendar: 'the SPX scan writes no 1DTE slice').

title: Market makers defending the contested strike
notes: refill share ranked vs this minute ('at or above the middle: defended / below the middle: abandoned'). Label's hit minimum is 10 hits, not the question's 3+. Missing 10-06 (no lob_flow tape).

title: One-sided 0DTE option flow
notes: label gives 3 bins (20%/80% rank lines); 5 bins come from parsing 'higher than k of n' (<=10% / <=20% / mid / >=80% / >=90%). Missing 10-06.

notes: terciles for today's book and the 1-7 day book (two clauses) plus delta share. Label shares are over the whole book, not limited to one 60-min expected move. Answer = 'today <share>; week <share>; delta <share>'.

title: Charm wall vs price (last two hours)
notes: only reads at/after 14:00. 'at price / near price / far from price' terciles + side from 'sigma above/below price'.

title: Heaviest strikes shifting
notes: parse which strike moved which way; both same way = both up/down, else 'closer together' = pulled in, 'further apart' = spread out.

title: Equal-weight vs cap-weight
notes: rank is of the size of the gap ('by size higher than k of n'); top third + 'above/below that' = more up/down.

title: Sector lockstep
notes: first tercile is the count of funds moving the index's way; a dispersion tercile follows as a second clause.

title: Cyclicals vs defensives rotation
notes: exact match: 'the sensitive sectors ahead / level / the defensives ahead'.

title: Semis lead beyond SPX
notes: fifths: top fifth more up, between in line, bottom fifth more down. Tape lane: first clause of tells.sector_lead_10m (multi-clause sentence, one per sector).

title: Opening breadth vs the gap (tape lane)
source: $ADD (market_context, derived live from $ADVN - $DECN since 88c7adc) x sign of gap.size; compare with prior mornings' $ADD at the same minute regressed on gap size (context_bars $ADD).
notes: no label: breadth.opening_tick is NYSE TICK, not $ADD. Archive has $ADD on tape reads only from 09-30 (5 days); history must come from store context_bars ($ADD from 08-11, 40 sessions, next-day clean). Same-day Schwab $ADD is wrong, so only the derived value is usable live. Built here as derived $ADD x gap side, ranked against prior sessions' same-minute value (no gap-size regression yet).

title: Stretch from VWAP
notes: side + tercile ('at VWAP / away from it / far from it'). Units are the read's sigma ruler, as asked.

title: Thin SPY book
notes: second clause 'the size showing at SPY's best bid and offer combined is in the bottom fifth / between / in the top fifth for HH:MM'.

title: Opening type
source: 09:30-09:59 1-min bars; references: prior session high/low (store spx_bars) and overnight /ES high/low converted to SPX by the 09:30 /ES-SPX basis (state/spx_jev/overnight). Drive = opens in the outer 10% of the 30-min range and closes in the opposite 20% without trading back through the open; test-then-drive = first tags a reference level (within a fixed tolerance) then closes in the far 20% the other way; else rotation.
notes: rules are not written anywhere yet; thresholds above are a draft. Answer is fixed from 10:00 for the rest of the day.

title: When the overnight range was built
source: overnight /ES 1-min bars (state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl, session != regular) from the 18:00 reopen to the read: late_share = 1 - range(bars before 03:00)/range(all bars); 'late' if late_share > the median of prior nights to the same time.
notes: overnight.gap_origin names the most unusual stretch, not the share of range built late. Store overnight_bars goes back to 03-05 (149 nights).

title: Overnight legs agree on direction
notes: FREE TEXT: verdict is the tail after 'so far.' ('N moved, all with the night's rise: one way' / 'split; the latest with...' / 'the latest against...' / 'Only one finished leg' / 'net move is quiet'). Legs judged 'moved' vs prior nights' same stretch. Live reads take the day's last premarket read.

title: Overnight path since the night's move (premarket)
options: built; since checkpoint small / no verdict
held; since checkpoint small / no verdict
faded; since checkpoint small / no verdict
reversed; since checkpoint small / no verdict
no real move; since checkpoint added
no real move; since checkpoint gave back
no real move; since checkpoint crossed 16:00
no real move; since checkpoint small / no verdict
notes: arc verdict words fixed in story.py (built/held/faded/reversed); checkpoint verdict 'the latest leg added / gave back / crossed their 16:00 price' (absent when the leg is small). Answer = '<arc>; since checkpoint <verdict>'. Live reads take the day's last premarket read.

title: State after an unscheduled burst
notes: FREE TEXT: fresh = 'inside the 10-minute fresh window'; round-tripped = 'given back N%, past the half line'; else settling. Extreme from shock.vs_day_range ('stayed inside' / 'still at the new extreme' / above it = given up). Only 3 of 7 live days had a shock. Answer = '<state>; <extreme>'.

title: Expiry and quarter-end calendar
notes: calendar-only, no market data; backfill is trivial for any date.

title: Bitcoin running ahead of SPX
notes: direction words 'ahead in the stocks-up / stocks-down direction / in line'; contrarian read applied downstream. Roll withholding: label is omitted across a /MBT roll. The contrarian lean is for the reader, not the answer.
